# Codemaxxing v1.3.11

This beta gives the entire app a more distinctive, production-ready visual
identity while keeping the workflow and layout testers already know.

## What changed

- A complete UI/UX refresh across the main workspace, chat, code blocks,
  onboarding, session creation, status chrome, and supporting controls.
- The built-in browser, new-tab experience, spaces, navigation rail, and
  page-aware assistant now share the same level of polish as the core app.
- A new signature midnight workbench theme, with cleaner light-theme surfaces
  and stronger responsive behavior.
- The new `>_<` Codemaxxing mark throughout the interface and in the native
  macOS, Windows, and Linux application icons.
- A safer macOS Terminal installer/updater that verifies the downloaded archive
  against the release's published SHA-256 checksum.
- Updated production dependency paths for Hono, `fast-uri`, and `ip-address`;
  the production dependency audit is clean.

## Install or update

### macOS (Apple Silicon)

Run this command for a first install or to replace an older version:

```bash
bash <(curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MarcosV6/codemaxxing-desktop/main/install-mac.sh)
```

Your sessions, settings, credentials, and projects remain intact. A manual
Apple Silicon zip is also attached below.

### Windows and Linux

Download the native installer for your platform from the assets below:

- Windows x64: setup `.exe` or portable `.zip`
- Linux x64: `.AppImage`, `.deb`, or `.tar.gz`

### Update a source checkout

```bash
git pull --ff-only origin main
npm ci
npm run electron:dev
```

Every attached package is built on its native GitHub runner, launch-smoked
before publication, and listed in `SHA256SUMS.txt`.
